description_zh: 让对象可以看见某个位置或其他对象。
description_en: Test if an object has line of sight to (if it can "see") an object or position.

conditions.description_zh: 测试在视线范围内，可否看到某个对象。
conditions.description_en: Test if there is line-of-sight to any instance of an object type.

params.desc_en: Choose the object to test if line-of-sight covers.
params.desc_zh: 选择要检查能否被视线看到的对象。

params.desc_en: The name or number of an image point in the object to test line-of-sight to. Leave 0 for object's origin.
params.desc_zh: 检查视线对象是否能发现另一个对象的图像点，可指定图像点的名称或编号。保留 0 为对象的图像原点。

conditions.description_zh: 检测对象是否拥有场景的某个位置的视线。
conditions.description_en: Test if there is line-of-sight to a position in the layout.

params.desc_en: The X co-ordinate to test line-of-sight to, in pixels.
params.desc_zh: 要检查是否拥有视线的X坐标，以像素为单位。

params.desc_en: The Y co-ordinate to test line-of-sight to, in pixels.
params.desc_zh: 要检查是否拥有视线的Y坐标，以像素为单位。

conditions.description_zh: 检测在场景任意 2 个位置之间，是否存在视线。
conditions.description_en: Test if there is line-of-sight between any two positions in the layout.

params.desc_en: The X co-ordinate to test line-of-sight from, in pixels.
params.desc_zh: 用于检测视线的第1个X坐标。

params.desc_en: The Y co-ordinate to test line-of-sight from, in pixels.
params.desc_zh: 用于检测视线的第1个Y坐标。

params.desc_en: The angle to orient the cone of view with, in degrees.
params.desc_zh: 用来确定视线方向的角度。

params.desc_en: The X co-ordinate to test line-of-sight to, in pixels.
params.desc_zh: 用于检测视线的第2个X坐标。

params.desc_en: The Y co-ordinate to test line-of-sight to, in pixels.
params.desc_zh: 用于检测视线的第2个Y坐标。

conditions.description_zh: 检查上次发出的射线是否命中障碍物。
conditions.description_en: Test if the last cast ray intersected an obstacle.

actions.description_zh: 设置视线能覆盖的最远距离，以像素为单位。
actions.description_en: Set the maximum range the line-of-sight can cover.

params.desc_en: The new maximum distance in pixels that line-of-sight can cover.
params.desc_zh: 视线能覆盖的最远距离，以像素为单位。

actions.description_zh: 设置视线在当前朝向能够覆盖的角度范围，以角度为单位。
actions.description_en: Set the angle range relative to the object angle that line-of-sight can cover.

params.desc_en: The new angle range in degrees relative to the object angle that line-of-sight can cover.
params.desc_zh: 视线在朝向能够覆盖的角度范围，以角度为单位。

actions.description_zh: 添加自定义对象作为视线遮挡物。
actions.description_en: Add a custom object as an obstacle to line-of-sight.

params.desc_en: Choose an object to add as an obstacle, obstructing line-of-sight.
params.desc_zh: 选择一个对象视为遮挡物，阻挡视线。

actions.description_zh: 删除所有已添加的障碍。
在任意两个坐标位置之间投出射线，检查是否有障碍物。
actions.description_en: Cast a ray between any two positions in the layout, checking for obstructions.
actions.display_en: Cast {my} ray from ({0}, {1}) to ({2}, {3}) (use collision cells [i]{4}[/i])

params.desc_en: The ray origin X co-ordinate.
params.desc_zh: 用于检测视线的第1个X坐标。

params.desc_en: The ray origin Y co-ordinate.
params.desc_zh: 用于检测视线的第1个Y坐标。

params.desc_en: The ray destination X co-ordinate.
params.desc_zh: 用于检测视线的第2个X坐标。

params.desc_en: The ray destination Y co-ordinate.
params.desc_zh: 用于检测视线的第2个Y坐标。

params.desc_en: Enabling usually improves performance, but can be slower over very long distances.
params.desc_zh: 启用此选项通常可以提升性能，但在检查较远的距离时，反而导致性能变慢。

expressions.description_zh: 返回视线当前的范围，以像素为单位。
expressions.description_en: Return the current range in pixels that line-of-sight can cover.

expressions.description_zh: 返回视线当前的覆盖角度，以像素为单位。
expressions.description_en: Return the current cone of view in degrees.

expressions.description_zh: 视线击中目标时，返回相交位置的X坐标。
expressions.description_en: Return the X position of the hit position.

expressions.description_zh: 视线击中目标时，返回相交位置的Y坐标。
expressions.description_en: Return the Y position of the hit position.

expressions.description_zh: 视线击中目标时，返回相交的实例对象UID。
expressions.description_en: Return the UID of the instance that was hit.

expressions.description_zh: 视线击中目标时，返回视线原点和相交位置的距离。
expressions.description_en: Return the distance between the ray origin and hit position.

expressions.description_zh: 视线击中目标后，返回命中沿法线延长指定距离位置的X坐标。
expressions.description_en: Return the X position at a distance along the hit normal.

params.desc_en: Length along the normal
params.desc_zh: 要沿法线延长的距离。

expressions.description_zh: 视线击中目标后，返回命中沿法线延长指定距离位置的Y坐标。
expressions.description_en: Return the Y position at a distance along the hit normal

params.desc_en: Length along the normal
params.desc_zh: 要沿法线延长的距离。

expressions.description_zh: 视线击中目标后，返回命中位置表面法线的角度。
expressions.description_en: Return the angle for the surface normal at the hit position.

expressions.description_zh: 视线击中目标后，返回沿法线反射角度指定距离位置的X坐标。
expressions.description_en: Return the X position at a distance along the hit reflection angle.

params.desc_en: Length along the reflection
params.desc_zh: 要沿反射法线延长的距离。

expressions.description_zh: 视线击中目标后，返回沿法线反射角度指定距离位置的Y坐标。
expressions.description_en: Return the Y position at a distance along the hit reflection angle.

params.desc_en: Length along the reflection
params.desc_zh: 要沿反射法线延长的距离。

expressions.description_zh: 视线击中目标后，返回命中位置反射的绝对角度。
expressions.description_en: Return the absolute angle of the ray reflection at the hit position.

properties.description_en: Choose whether solids obstruct LOS or if to use custom objects added by events.
properties.description_zh: 选择哪些对象可以被视线对象识别为遮挡物，阻挡视线。选择 '自定义' 将由事件添加。

properties.description_en: The maximum distance in pixels that line-of-sight can cover.
properties.description_zh: 视线能覆盖的最远距离，以像素为单位。

properties.description_en: The angle range in degrees relative to the object angle that line-of-sight can cover.
properties.description_zh: 视线在朝向能覆盖的角度范围，以角度为单位。

properties.description_en: Enabling usually improves performance, but can be slower over very long distances.
properties.description_zh: 启用此选项通常可以提升性能，若目标在距离很远的地方，性能反而会变慢。
